mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances with FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation requiring aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances with CPIAUCSL > 3.0% (y/y), or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate collapsing consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint HOUST/RSAFS decline fails to predict negative SPX returns in >40% of cases over 3-year rolling windows, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.5%), declining payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals economic deterioration, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances with UNRATE > 5.5% and PAYEMS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening supply capacity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth fails to predict positive SPX 60-day returns in >40% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: New housing starts falling below 1,100,000 units (HOUST < 1100.0) signal weakening consumer confidence, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances with HOUST < 1100.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) signal aggressive monetary tightening amid inflation, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint FEDFUNDS/CPIAUCSL increase fails to predict negative SPX 5-day returns in >40% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high retail sales regimes (RSAFS > 450000.0), declining housing starts (HOUST) indicate shifting consumer spending patterns, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances with RSAFS > 450000.0 and HOUST declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
